speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Against the notch. A full thumb short, and the price is still a penny. I am not cutting another to make it look honest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny, then. I'll eat the side that doesn't answer.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The left side. You came in with a hand to it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit. The back is the same back you took to church. Do not tell me it has become a different complaint because the tooth is louder.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The back is the back. I am not mending it with talk.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leave the cat. He is not the dinner. Alse, the jug, and then you may sit.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No speech. The sermon gave me nothing, and I am not inventing one to pay for the loaf.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. The loaf is a thumb short. The tooth may have the soft of it. I will not have the house fed on hints.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I'll eat. The back can wait till evening. I'll walk it then, and not before.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Evening, then. A penny is the whole of the business on this board.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I'll put the rest under the cloth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Under the cloth. I am not bringing a page to this table.
